relations.text: C.H. RobinsonがRXOを買収する合併契約(2026年10月)
relations.text_en: C.H. Robinson agreed to acquire RXO (merger agreement, October 2026)

source.label: C.H. Robinson 8-K(2026年11月)
source.quote: ("RXO") pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of October 4, 2026 (the "Merger Agreement" and such acquisition, the "RXO Acquisition"), and the related financing transactions.

relations.text: トラック仲介の最大手で、主な競合
relations.text_en: Largest freight broker and main rival

source.label: RXO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors include C.H. Robinson, Echo Global Logistics, Expeditors, Forward Air, Flexport, J.B. Hunt, Landstar System, Total Quality Logistics, and Uber Freight.

relations.text: トラック仲介事業CoyoteをUPSから10.38億ドルで買収(2024年9月)
relations.text_en: Bought the Coyote truck brokerage business from UPS for $1.038 billion (September 2024)

source.label: RXO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On September 16, 2024, the Company acquired the technology-driven, asset-light truckload freight brokerage services business, as well as certain assets used to conduct haulage, dedicated transport and warehousing services in the United Kingdom (collectively, "Coyote"), from United Parcel Service of America, Inc. ("UPS") and certain subsidiaries of UPS.
